      The shop

      A neighborhood shop that treats you like family

      Go With The Flow is a Latino-owned barbershop on Mission Ave run by Flo, a barber who built a loyal following one chair at a time. It opened in 2024, minutes from the pier and Camp Pendleton. Military, kids and first-timers are all welcome.

      • Free shampoowith every cut
      • Free hot towelsteamed, every time
      • Free parkingright out front
